tools.name: check_ip_blocklists
tools.description: Checks IPv4 addresses against 12 free public blocklists (IPsum, FireHOL levels 1-3, Spamhaus DROP, blocklist.de, CINS Army, GreenSnow, DShield, ET compromised, Tor exits), the same lists as logtriage.app's IP blocklist checker. Accepts a list of addresses or any text containing them (log lines, CSV)
